name: net.textproto
doc:
Text protocols (SMTP, HTTP/1, MIME): MIME headers with canonical keys
and continuation lines, dot-encoding of message bodies, and numeric
response lines ("250-..."/"250 ...").

items.name: CanonicalKey
items.doc:
The canonical form of a MIME header key: the first letter and each
letter after a '-' upper case, the rest lower case ("content-type" ->
"Content-Type"). Keys with spaces or other invalid bytes stay as they are.
items.summary: The canonical form of a MIME header key: the first letter and each letter after a '-' upper case, the rest lower case ("content-type" -> "Content-Type").

items.name: DotEncode
items.doc:
Dot-encodes a message body (SMTP DATA): lines starting with '.' get a
second '.', line ends become \r\n, and the ".\r\n" terminator is added.
items.summary: Dot-encodes a message body (SMTP DATA): lines starting with '.' get a second '.', line ends become \r\n, and the ".\r\n" terminator is added.

items.name: ReadHeader
items.signature: func ReadHeader(text string, from int) HeaderResult!
items.doc:
Reads a MIME header from text at offset `from`: "Key: value" lines
(continuation lines starting with a space or tab are joined), ended by
an empty line (\r\n or \n). A missing blank line at the end of text is
accepted.
items.summary: Reads a MIME header from text at offset `from`: "Key: value" lines (continuation lines starting with a space or tab are joined), ended by an empty line (\r\n or \n).

items.name: ReadResponse
items.signature: func ReadResponse(text string, from int, expect int) Response!
items.doc:
Reads a (possibly multi-line, "250-...") response at offset from; with
expect > 0 the code must start with expect's digits (2 accepts 2xx).
items.summary: Reads a (possibly multi-line, "250-...") response at offset from; with expect > 0 the code must start with expect's digits (2 accepts 2xx).

items.name: DotResult
items.doc:
Decodes a dot-encoded body up to the "." line: the body (with \n line
ends) and the offset after the terminator. Fails if there is none.
items.summary: Decodes a dot-encoded body up to the "." line: the body (with \n line ends) and the offset after the terminator.

items.name: Header
items.doc:
A MIME header: keys in canonical form, several values per key, keys
kept in first-seen order.
items.summary: A MIME header: keys in canonical form, several values per key, keys kept in first-seen order.

members.name: Get
members.doc: The first value of key ("" if absent).
members.summary: The first value of key ("" if absent).

members.name: String
members.doc:
"Key: value\r\n" lines (keys sorted, as Go's Header.Write), without
the blank line that ends a header.
members.summary: "Key: value\r\n" lines (keys sorted, as Go's Header.Write), without the blank line that ends a header.

items.name: HeaderResult
items.doc: A parsed header and where it ended.
items.summary: A parsed header and where it ended.

members.name: End
members.doc: Byte offset just after the blank line that ends the header.
members.summary: Byte offset just after the blank line that ends the header.

items.name: Response
items.doc: A numeric response: code and the message (lines joined with \n).
items.summary: A numeric response: code and the message (lines joined with \n).
